# coarsen to

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:coarsenTo`](gmeow-coarsenTo.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/coarsenTo>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/kernel`](../../slices/kernel.md)

Disclosure control: marks a value/relator so that at projection time it is generalized to no finer than the named [`gmeow:GranularityLevel`](../classes/gmeow-GranularityLevel.md) — a coarser ancestor is emitted instead of the precise value (e.g. an enclosing city rather than exact coordinates), never by deletion. The generalization sibling of [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false (withhold); together they are the single 'withhold or coarsen under a trigger' mechanism of CONSTITUTION P10. Domain-free, like [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md). The coarse value is obtained by walking [`gmeow:generalizesVia`](gmeow-generalizesVia.md) (default [`gmeow:partOf`](gmeow-partOf.md)); any geometry/geomask computation stays in the solver layer (P12). When both apply, displayable false (withhold) wins over coarsen.
